messages:
morgan: Heads-up incoming pen test week of Aug 2. Need owners for RBAC, KMS, evidence handoff, and triage.

aj: I can own KMS runbook. We should create a pt-evidence CMK and avoid giving assessors decrypt on prod keys. Issue short-lived grants.

kevin: I'll handle packaging + presigned URL flow. Suggest 24h presigned links and object-lock retention.

rachel: I will build the impact matrix (service, sensitivity, temp-roles, evidence location). Sheet link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/pt-example

morgan: DevOps infra needed for alias + param entries. @devops-bot please open ticket.

devops-bot: INFRA-PT-7201 created. Tues pairing ok.

security-bot: Assessor tentative slots Aug 3-5 and Aug 10-12; confirm by Jul 25.

aj: Runbook highlights I'll add: create CMK alias/pt-evidence, packager uses GenerateDataKey, grants issued only for Decrypt with GrantId, revoke grants and rotate post-engagement, verify CloudTrail logs for kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey.

kevin: Draft role policy: allow s3:GetObject to pt-evidence-bucket, kms:Decrypt conditioned on kms:GrantId. Fill GrantId at issuance.

rachel: For remediation tracking use vuln board tag pt-7201 and include 'verified-by-assessor' checkbox.

morgan: Assign triage lead aj, ops fixes kevin, evidence rachel. Reconvene Mon EOD for signoff. :thumbsup:
